title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (React & Python)
description: We are seeking a Full-Stack Software Engineer proficient in building robust RESTful microservices with Python and reactive web dashboards in React.js. Responsibilities include designing scalable relational database schemas in SQL, developing client-side interactive analytics views, and collaborating on API contracts.

title: Data Analyst & BI Specialist
description: Looking for a Data Analyst to transform complex business datasets into intuitive dashboards. Candidate will write advanced SQL queries, build Star-schema data models in Power BI, author DAX measures for variance and trend tracking, and communicate data-driven recommendations.

title: Machine Learning Engineer (NLP / Computer Vision)
description: Seeking an ML Engineer to contribute to text analysis pipelines and convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures. Experience with tokenization, semantic embedding matching, classification metrics (F1, Precision, Recall), and model latency optimization is required.
